notes.title: 🚀 Space Scum Playtest Update
notes.content: [h1]🛰️ [b]Incoming Transmission, Mercenaries![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]The galaxy just got a little safer and a little smarter. Version [b]0.6.5.16[/b] is live with plenty of fixes, smarter AI, and quality of life improvements that should make your battles more fair and your missions more reliable.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]🔧 [b]Latest Patch Notes[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3]💥 [b]Crash Fixes & Stability[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when a crew member had more than 10 abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when opening a Robot Systems shop[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game not fully closing on Steam[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Gameplay Fixes & QoL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed characters appearing to have more Focus than they actually do due to rounding up[/p][/*][*][p]Status effects are no longer applied to downed characters in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Automated Sentries are no longer included in checks to see if a team has been wiped out in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Player crew members who are downed in battle now have a chance to survive at the end (provided they still have a head attached)[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missions sometimes being created for non-existent enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missions not spawning or vanishing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed hair turning white on characters that were downed in a tactical battle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed footprints on the world map not saving or loading correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Game now auto pauses on load, when leaving a settlement or when closing the crew menu (settings menu toggles for these will come in a later update)[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]Combat & Balance[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed some area of effect attacks not correctly displaying their targeted tiles[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the difficulty display of some enemy packs on the world map not matching their actual difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed enemies using abilities when they did not have enough Focus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some higher tier weapons not having the correct damage[/p][/*][*][p]Force Field and Armour Penetration now scales with the targets remaining Force Field or Armour[/p][/*][*][p]Durability of equipment has changed, lower quality items now have less and higher quality items now have more[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Shield item tooltip displaying unnecessary data[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧠 [b]AI Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]AI is now more aggressive when they or their team mates are targeted[/p][/*][*][p]AI should now know the requirements to use certain abilities[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛒 [b]Economy & Missions[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Mission reward money has been reworked, generally courier missions reward less[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that could make a courier missions secondary objective impossible[/p][/*][/list][h3]🖊️ [b]Miscellaneous[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed typos[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed game rolling a D101 rather than a D100[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed line of sight issues with outdoor battles with elevations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]📡 [b]That's All For Now[/b][/h2][p]As always, keep sending us your thoughts through the [url="https://forms.gle/X4MHuVY8CMtARcA69"]Feedback Form[/url] (you can also find it in the Main Menu). Every report helps us improve Space Scum during the Playtest.[/p][p]And if you want to keep up with development, chat with the community, and talk directly to us, join us on [url="https://discord.gg/7xYdPN3UhP"]Discord[/url]![/p][p][/p][p][i]Until next time, stay scrappy and watch your six![/i][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Looking for more?[/b][/p][p]Another Forklift-published game [b]Roman Triumph[/b] has just launched in 1.0! 🏛️[/p][p]Build your city, defend it from invaders, please the gods, and see how long you can survive 👇🏻[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1864880/Roman_Triumph_Survival_City_Builder/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2601980/view/500584797655010475"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: 🛰️ Your Bests, Your Worsts, and Steve – Devlog #1
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hey everyone 👋[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]You’ve told us some pretty interesting and weird stuff recently. In this first devlog we’ll be reviewing all the things you apparently like and dislike.[/p][p]But first off, it's worth noting we didn’t expect so many of you to play the open playtest. [b]Over 5000[/b] [b]people[/b] [b]have given it a try[/b] and almost [b]400 of you completed a feedback form[/b]. That’s over 6,500 bits of feedback in the forms alone, not mentioning those of you that contacted us on [url="https://discord.gg/P6ZAE4FVra"]Discord [/url]and Steam![/p][p][/p][h3]🚀 [b]You all totally disagree on weapons (and that’s good!)[/b][/h3][p]We’ve really strived to balance ranged weapons (melee is coming later). Earlier builds had a ridiculously overpowered Assault Rifle that was long range, incredibly accurate and extremely powerful. We nerfed the Assault Rifle and tried to give each weapon a niche in an attempt to give the game some balance. The stats speak for themselves:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646335/ad4ad8dded406b2772499deca0370720676623fc.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re really pleased about the variety of responses here, it suggests a certain amount of balance between the weapons. For example, to see roughly as many people love the shotgun as hate it [i]is great[/i]. We want you to play the game differently and there to be no one “correct” meta. [/p][p]It’s also interesting because in previous playtests we’ve had people feel like Melee combat has been both overpowered and at other times underpowered. We modified some of the damage values and skills to help bring it into the fore and feel valuable, so it’s great to see a melee weapon in the top 3![/p][p]We’re also continuing to think about synergies between the different weapons. For example, the Pistol’s “Execute” works well on enemies affected by the SMG’s “Suppress”. This allows you to spray an area with SMG fire then have your pistols go in and murder enemies whilst they cower. Expect more of these![/p][p][/p][h3]👨‍🚀 [b]Your personal lives keep getting in the way of gaming[/b][/h3][p]One of the questions was “When did you stop playing, and why?”. This was really meant to determine if there was a specific game related reason that ended your playthrough, such as a bug, or a balancing issue. Instead, we got lots of details about your personal lives, [i]which was genuinely great[/i]. [/p][list][*][p][i]“i was playing while working, work is over”[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]“I have to pee...”[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]“I would've kept going, but it was dark.”[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]“Time to go to bed”[/i][/p][/*][*][p][i]“I only stopped playing to go to work”[/i][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]Are we having fun yet?[/b][/h3][p]It’s always pretty nerve wracking to see if players actually like your game. It’s er, pretty important! Those of you that filled in the feedback form seem to be enjoying yourself thankfully - 89.6%[b] [/b]of you would recommend the game and average enjoyment was 7.74/10. This figure went up to 8.30 after updates.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646335/f07377c27b7e617aaa8e34ecda77d596d7dfa5a3.png"][/img]We’re really glad to see this as we’ve revamped the difficulty curve a number of times. We originally had the second dungeon be filled with Mercenaries, but that ended up being too deadly (as some of you may know!), so we tweaked it to Scavengers. We eased off the brutality of the wandering encounters to allow players to recover and level up their squad if needed to between story missions (Though some of our mobs may have been too hard even then...no names [spoiler] (Molten Cragborn) [/spoiler]).[/p][p][/p][h3]🩸 [b]Definitely got time to bleed[/b][/h3][p]It’s great to see so many of you enjoying long playthroughs of Space Scum. Especially given we’ve still got so much more content/polish/new systems to put into the game:[/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646335/9ccaa2c0923e127bf06d66f8b2f426ff740a17c8.png"][/img][/h3][h3]🪐 [b]Something’s missing[/b][/h3][p]We know there’s lots of things missing but it’s still interesting to see where you think the issues are. The 5 most requested things were:[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646335/558d0ffe43df8496df3316c164f702c7a368f10b.png"][/img]Comments about the UI confirmed much of what we already thought – that it needs some attention. Besides revisiting the general usability aspects of the UI, we’re also producing some mock ups in a new style. This should simultaneously give the game a visual boost and make it more fun to play. New UI screenshots will be shared shortly![/p][h3]
🛸 [b]Origin Gangsters [/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646335/9d905a3c60f3180f86faf563c6900f755f69cf3e.png"][/img][/p][p]If we’re honest, most of the origins were last minute additions - we really weren’t expecting many people to try origins beyond the tutorial but as it turns out over 50% of you did?! It’s great that you wanted to try the variety and the different starts, it means we know they’re important to you and we’re definitely going to make sure they’re scaled, balanced and tweaked to be good fun for when the demo comes out.[/p][h3]
🛠️ [b]Future Scum Logs[/b][/h3][p]We’ll be doing regular devlogs from now on. Future updates will give you more of an insight into what has been happening on the day-to-day dev and the thinking behind the design decisions being made. [/p][p]And finally…thanks for all your help and feedback, lots of which has already been acted on. In the most literal sense we’ve have been overwhelmed by this, but that really is great![/p][p]
[/p][p][i]Simon & Ed[/i][/p][p]
[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"][b]Looking for more?[/b][/p][p align="start"]Another Forklift-published game [b]Roman Triumph[/b] has just launched in 1.0! 🏛️[/p][p align="start"]Build your city, defend it from invaders, please the gods, and see how long you can survive 👇🏻[/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1864880/Roman_Triumph_Survival_City_Builder/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

changing the game speed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed typos and text alignment errors[/p][/*][/list][h3]🎯 [b]New Skills & Abilities[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Side Step[/b] lets the user move freely this turn notes.title: 🚀 The Playtest Continues!
notes.content:
[h1]Hey everyone 👋[/h1][p][/p][p]Exactly one week ago we launched the [i]Open Playtest[/i] for Space Scum, and we’ve been blown away by the response. Thousands of you have already jumped in, poked at systems, broken things in creative ways, and left us a ton of valuable feedback![/p][p]We can’t thank you enough ❤️[/p][p]In just the first three days, we shipped [b]three major patches[/b] with fixes, balance tweaks, and quality-of-life improvements, all based directly on what you told us. Your reports, comments, and suggestions have helped us improve the game quickly and meaningfully.[/p][p][/p][h2]🟢 The Playtest is staying open for now![/h2][p]We want you to be part of this journey as we continue building and improving the game. Keeping the Playtest open means you’ll get access to upcoming changes as soon as they’re ready![/p][p]In the coming weeks, we’ll also start publishing [b]Dev Logs[/b]. These will give you a closer look at how Space Scum is being made, what’s next on our roadmap, what we’re still figuring out, and what we’ve learned so far.[/p][p][/p][h2]💫 How to Join the Playtest[/h2][p]If you haven’t joined yet, it’s easy:[/p][olist][*][p]Go to the Space Scum Steam page[/p][/*][*][p]Scroll down to the [b]Playtest section[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Click the [b]Request Access[/b] button[/p][/*][*][p]Steam will grant access automatically, and the Playtest will appear in your Library[/p][/*][/olist][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601980/Space_Scum/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]🤝 Help the project[/h2][list][*][p][url="https://forms.gle/DP1zT7EQE8eewMDe8"]Leave your feedback[/url] after a session. Even a single paragraph helps a lot.[/p][/*][*][p]Wishlist the game on Steam if you haven’t yet. It really boosts visibility.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/P6ZAE4FVra"]Discord [/url]to chat with us and other players[/p][/*][/list][p]
See you out there, Scum! 🛸[/p][p][/p][p]  [i]— The Space Scum Team[/i]

[/p]

notes.title: 💥 Jump In: Space Scum Open Playtest Week
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 Space Scum Open Playtest is live all week[/h1][p][/p][p]This is an early build and we are opening it for a full week because your opinion matters most right now. Jump in, try whatever weird ideas you have, and tell us what clicks and what doesn't. Your feedback will guide our next steps![/p][p][/p][h2]🟢 How to join[/h2][olist][*][p]Open the Space Scum page on Steam[/p][/*][*][p]Hit the big green button to install, then launch the Open Playtest build[/p][/*][/olist][p]Play as much as you like through September 9[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="6AVv3_evYzc;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601980/Space_Scum/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h2]🎯 What we want to hear your thoughts on[/h2][list][*][p]Core combat feel, pacing, and moment to moment choices[/p][/*][*][p]Early game onboarding, how quickly you understand what to do[/p][/*][*][p]Performance on your setup, frame rate and stability[/p][/*][*][p]Any rough edges in menus, tooltips, and readability[/p][/*][/list][p]If something surprises you, good or bad, we want to know about it![/p][p][/p][h2]📝 Send feedback from inside the game[/h2][p]Open the feedback form from the Main Menu. Short notes are great, detailed write ups are amazing. If you record something, drop a link to the video. Specs help when you report performance. Every report goes straight to the devs![/p][p][/p][h2]❓ Quick answers[/h2][list][*][p]Free to play for the entire week, no keys needed[/p][/*][*][p]Streaming and videos are welcome. Tag us if you post, or drop a link in our [url="https://discord.gg/P6ZAE4FVra"]Discord[/url][/p][/*][*][p]The build is in early development, some things will change[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]🤝 Help the project[/h2][list][*][p]Leave your feedback after a session, even a single paragraph helps a lot[/p][/*][*][p]Wishlist the game on Steam if you have not yet, it really boosts visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/P6ZAE4FVra"]Discord[/url] to chat with the team and other players[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for testing, for caring, and for pushing Space Scum forward. See you out there, Scum![/p][p][/p][p]  [i]— The Space Scum Team[/i]

[/p]

notes.title: 💥 Check Your Library, Recruit – Space Scum Needs You Again!
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 Opening Access to the Second Wave of Playtesters[/h2][p][/p][p]Today we are expanding the Space Scum playtest with a [b]second wave of invites[/b]. This means additional players are joining the mission, but the first wave of playtesters still have full access.[/p][p]Why is that important? Because we have updated the playtest build based on the feedback from the first wave. Many of you told us the game felt a bit too easy last time, so we've ramped up the challenge. What do you think now? :)[/p][p][b]Even if you have played before, we need you back in to see the changes[/b], try the new adjustments, and let us know how it feels![/p][h2][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646335/270fcd5884327d8f1cb161641ae94baa213f2d82.gif"][/img][/h2][p]If you requested access but did not get in during the first wave, check your Steam library, notifications, or the Space Scum store page. You might already be cleared for boarding.[/p][p][/p][h2]👇🏻 Friend invites will be re-enabled[/h2][p]If you have access, you can invite one friend to join:[/p][olist][*][p]Open your Steam friends list[/p][/*][*][p]Right click a friend’s name[/p][/*][*][p]Select “Invite to Playtest” under the Space Scum entry[/p][/*][/olist][p]❗️[b]Only one invite per playtester, so choose wisely.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]🛠 Help Us Make It Better[/h2][p]Whether you are brand new or returning from the first wave, we want your honest feedback. Tell us what you enjoyed, what did not work for you, and what could be improved. Even short answers help. The [url="https://forms.gle/1K9iTfzEmeXxcCwn8"]Feedback Form[/url] link is in the Main Menu, please take a few minutes after your session to fill it out.[/p][p]⚠️ [i]If you played in the first wave, we recommend starting a new game. Old saves may have bugs or be incompatible with the updated build.[/i][/p][p]Thank you for being part of this journey and helping us shape Space Scum. We will see you out there, scavengers.[/p][p][/p][p]  [i]— The Space Scum Team[/i]

[/p]

notes.title: 💥 Check Your Library, Recruit – Space Scum Needs You!
notes.content:
[h2][b]🚀 First Wave of Playtest Invites Sent![/b][/h2][p][/p][p]Over the past few weeks, we've been gathering requests to join the Space Scum playtest, and we’re truly blown away by your enthusiasm. Thank you so much to everyone who signed up![/p][p]We’ve just approved access for several hundred players, and the first wave of invitations is now live.
If you requested access, make sure to check your [b]Steam library[/b], [b]notifications[/b], or the [b]Space Scum store page[/b]. The playtest may already be waiting for you there.[/p][p][/p][h3]👇🏻 And here's more good news [/h3][p]
We’ve enabled the [b]friend invite system[/b].
That means if you already have access, you can now invite [b]one[/b] [b]friend[/b] to join the playtest.[/p][p][/p][h3]To invite someone:[/h3][list][*][p]Open your Steam friends list[/p][/*][*][p]Right-click a friend’s name[/p][/*][*][p]Select [b]“Invite to Playtest”[/b] under the Space Scum entry[/p][/*][/list][p]❗️Please note: [b]invites are limited to one per playtester[/b], so choose wisely.[/p][p]If you know someone who would enjoy leading a ragtag team of mercs across brutal, procedurally generated planets in a gritty turn-based RPG, this is their chance to join the scum of the 'verse. Whether they’re into tactical choices, permadeath tension, or just love telling their own story in a harsh sci-fi universe, they might be the perfect addition to the playtest.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646335/5fcc0ce5d3c1542a833c3eeb7954c68266d9a952.gif"][/img][/p][p]⚠️ If you've played before, we've made quite a few changes so you'll want to start a new game - [b]old saves[/b] will have bugs and might be [b]entirely incompatible[/b]! ⚠️[/p][p][/p][h2]🛠 Help Us Make It Better[/h2][p]Once you're in the game, you’ll find a link to our [b]Feedback Form[/b] in the [b]Main Menu[/b]. We would really appreciate it if you take a few minutes to share your impressions. It helps us polish the experience ahead of the upcoming demo release![/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for being part of this journey. See you in the void, scavengers![/p][p][/p][p]  [i]— The Space Scum Team[/i]

[/p]

notes.title: 🪐 Welcome to Space Scum
notes.content:
[h3]Hey there, commander![/h3]

We just launched the Space Scum Steam page and you're among the first to see it. This is a brutal, turn-based and tactical RPG, where you lead a crew of mercenaries through hostile planets, risky missions and tough choices. Procedural maps, permanent death, exotic weapons… Survival is never guaranteed. And that’s exactly the point!

💥 Build your squad. Make the hard calls. Fight to stay alive. Become the most feared crew in the galaxy…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45646335/4dbdc9c9dffabdd8201d2cea428b20970709ed23.gif[/img]

If you are ready to get your hands dirty, you can request [b]access to the playtest right now[/b] on the store page. The first wave of players is going in soon. Your feedback will help shape the future of the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601980/Space_Scum/

Developed by [b]Sole Survivor Games[/b] and published by [b]Forklift Interactive[/b], Space Scum is just getting started. Thanks for joining us at the beginning. More transmissions coming soon!

[i]— The Space Scum Team[/i]
